vigilancia.ayuda: If the new file carries the «{objetivo}» column with what really happened, see how the model does today against what it scored on its test, and whether it is time to retrain it.
vigilancia.sin_objetivo: This file does not carry the «{objetivo}» column: to watch the performance, upload new rows that have the real result.
vigilancia.sin_referencia: This model does not carry its test figure to compare against, so it cannot be watched.
vigilancia.error: The performance could not be watched ({motivo}). Load the file again to try once more.
vigilancia.sin_filas: No row carries a real result the model knows: there is nothing to measure it with.

veredicto.sigue: Keeps going: today it does as well as on its test.
veredicto.revisar: Review: today it does worse than on its test, but with these rows you cannot tell it is more than chance.
veredicto.revisar_pocas: Review: with so few rows you cannot decide whether today it does better or worse than on its test.
veredicto.revisar_indefinida: Review: on these rows the figure cannot be calculated, so nothing is decided.
veredicto.reentrenar: Retrain: today it does clearly worse than on its test, beyond the margin of error.

vigilancia.pocas: With only {n} rows with a real result nothing is decided: review the model with more rows.
vigilancia.indefinida: On these rows the figure is not defined (one of the two classes is missing, or there is no real positive, or the model predicted none): the number above is a default value, not a measurement.
vigilancia.cifras: {metric}: today {hoy}, with a 95 % interval from {bajo} to {alto} ({n} rows); on its test, {prueba}.
vigilancia.dejadas: {vacias} rows without a result and {desconocidas} with a result the model never saw were left out.
vigilancia.empate: A difference of up to {empate} counts as a tie.
vigilancia.detalle: The interval is how much today's figure would change if these rows were another sample of the same kind ({remuestreos} resamples, seed {semilla}). The test figure is a single number: the model file does not keep its margin.

protocolo.titulo: A model saved from the Protocol DS
protocolo.resumen: {dataset}: the winner of the Protocol ({modelo}), tested in stage 8 and fitted on {filas} training rows.
protocolo.prueba: On the test that was opened once, {metric} was {valor} ({n} rows).
protocolo.no_trae: It carries no league, no comparison with a baseline and no leak findings: the Protocol does not measure them that way. It serves to score new rows and to watch their performance.
